moments.author: Mark Zuckerberg
moments.quote: Every lab has the responsibility and incentive to move at the pace required to train its models safely… engaging independent evaluators and advisors is industry best practice.
moments.why: He pushed back on calls for a coordinated AI slowdown, arguing for lab-level safety measures instead.

moments.author: Mark Zuckerberg
moments.quote: It’s up to each AI company to make sure its technology is safe… Each lab has the responsibility and incentive to move at the pace required to train its models safely.
moments.why: He publicly distanced Meta from calls for a coordinated industry-wide AI slowdown.

moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Sources: Hall-of-Fame QB Drew Brees mulled playing for the Denver Broncos in last season’s AFC Championship game.
moments.why: A major NFL legend considering a playoff return lit up sports timelines and sparked massive debate.
